questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Natural rubber has
questions.questionTa: இயற்கை இரப்பர் பெற்றுள்ள வடிவமைப்பு
questions.explanationEn: Natural rubber is cis-1,4-polyisoprene, in which all double bonds have cis-configuration.
questions.explanationTa: இயற்கை இரப்பர் என்பது சிஸ்-1,4-பாலிஐசோபுரீன் ஆகும்; இது அனைத்தும் சிஸ் (all cis) வடிவமைப்பைக் கொண்டுள்ளது.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Nylon is an example of
questions.questionTa: நைலான் என்பது எதற்கு எடுத்துக்காட்டு?
questions.explanationEn: Nylons (such as Nylon-6,6, Nylon-6, Nylon-2-Nylon-6) contain amide linkages (−CONH−) and are polyamides.
questions.explanationTa: நைலான் பலபடிகள் அமைடு பிணைப்புகளைக் (−CONH−) கொண்ட பாலிஅமைடுகள் ஆகும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Terylene is an example of
questions.questionTa: டெரிலீன் என்பது எதற்கு எடுத்துக்காட்டு?
questions.explanationEn: Terylene (Dacron) is formed by condensation of ethylene glycol and terephthalic acid and is a polyester.
questions.explanationTa: எத்திலீன் கிளைக்கால் மற்றும் டெரிப்தாலிக் அமிலத்திலிருந்து உருவாகும் டெரிலீன் (டாக்ரான்) ஒரு பாலிஎஸ்டர் ஆகும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Which is the monomer of neoprene in the following?
questions.questionTa: பின்வருவனவற்றுள் நியோபுரீனின் ஒற்றைப்படி (monomer) எது?
questions.explanationEn: Neoprene is formed by free-radical polymerization of chloroprene (2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene, CH₂=C(Cl)–CH=CH₂).
questions.explanationTa: நியோபுரீனின் ஒற்றைப்படி குளோரோபுரீன் எனப்படும் 2-குளோரோபியூட்டா-1,3-டையீன் (CH₂=C(Cl)–CH=CH₂) ஆகும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Which one of the following is a bio-degradable polymer?
questions.questionTa: பின்வருவனவற்றுள் எது மக்கும் பலபடி (bio-degradable polymer)?
questions.explanationEn: PHBV (Poly(3-hydroxybutyrate-co-3-hydroxyvalerate)) is a biodegradable copolymer decomposed by microorganisms.
questions.explanationTa: PHBV (பாலி(3-ஹைட்ராக்சிபியூட்டிரேட்-கோ-3-ஹைட்ராக்சிவேலரேட்)) என்பது நுண்ணுயிரிகளால் சிதைக்கப்படும் மக்கும் பலபடியாகும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Non-stick cookwares generally have a coating of a polymer, whose monomer is
questions.questionTa: ஒட்டாத சமையல் பாத்திரங்களில் பூசப்படும் பலபடியின் ஒற்றைப்படி எது?
questions.explanationEn: Non-stick cookware is coated with Teflon (polytetrafluoroethylene, PTFE), whose monomer is tetrafluoroethene (CF₂=CF₂).
questions.explanationTa: ஒட்டாத சமையல் பாத்திரங்களில் பூசப்படும் டெஃப்லான் (PTFE) பலபடியின் ஒற்றைப்படி டெட்ராபுளூரோஎத்தீன் (CF₂=CF₂) ஆகும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Assertion: 2-methyl-1,3-butadiene is the monomer of natural rubber. Reason: Natural rubber is formed through anionic addition polymerisation.
questions.questionTa: கூற்று: 2-மெத்தில்-1,3-பியூட்டாடையீன் என்பது இயற்கை இரப்பரின் ஒற்றைப்படியாகும். காரணம்: இயற்கை இரப்பர் எதிரயனி சேர்க்கைப் பலபடியாக்கல் மூலம் உருவாகிறது.
optionsEn: If both assertion and reason are true and reason is the correct explanation of assertion
if both assertion and reason are true but reason is not the correct explanation of assertion
assertion is true but reason is false
both assertion and reason are false
optionsTa: கூற்று மற்றும் காரணம் இரண்டும் சரி, மேலும் காரணம் கூற்றிற்கான சரியான விளக்கமாகும்
கூற்று மற்றும் காரணம் இரண்டும் சரி, ஆனால் காரணம் கூற்றிற்கான சரியான விளக்கமல்ல
questions.explanationEn: Assertion is true (isoprene, 2-methyl-1,3-butadiene, is the monomer of natural rubber), whereas Reason is false.
questions.explanationTa: கூற்று சரி (ஐசோபுரீன் எனப்படும் 2-மெத்தில்-1,3-பியூட்டாடையீன் இயற்கை இரப்பரின் ஒற்றைப்படி), ஆனால் காரணம் தவறு.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Which of the following is a co-polymer?
questions.questionTa: பின்வருவனவற்றுள் எது இணைப் பலபடி (co-polymer)?
questions.explanationEn: PHBV is a copolymer formed from two different monomers: 3-hydroxybutanoic acid and 3-hydroxypentanoic acid. Orlon, PVC, and Teflon are homopolymers.
questions.explanationTa: PHBV என்பது 3-ஹைட்ராக்சிபியூட்டனாயிக் அமிலம் மற்றும் 3-ஹைட்ராக்சிபென்டனாயிக் அமிலம் ஆகிய இரு வேறு ஒற்றைப்படிகளால் ஆன இணைப் பலபடியாகும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: The polymer used in making blankets (artificial wool) is
questions.questionTa: போர்வைகள் (செயற்கை கம்பளி) தயாரிக்கப் பயன்படும் பலபடி எது?
questions.explanationEn: Polyacrylonitrile (PAN, also known as Orlon or Acrilan) is used as a substitute for wool in making blankets and sweaters.
questions.explanationTa: பாலிஅக்ரிலோநைட்ரைல் (PAN / ஆர்லான்) செயற்கை கம்பளியாகப் போர்வைகள் மற்றும் ஸ்வெட்டர்கள் தயாரிக்கப் பயன்படுகிறது.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Regarding cross-linked or network polymers, which of the following statement is incorrect? (NEET)
questions.questionTa: குறுக்குப் பிணைப்பு அல்லது வலைப்பின்னல் பலபடிகளைப் பொறுத்தவரையில் பின்வரும் எந்தக் கூற்று தவறானது? (NEET)
optionsEn: They are formed from bi and tri-functional monomers
They contain covalent bonds between various linear polymer chains
They contain strong covalent bonds in their polymer chain
optionsTa: இவை இரு மற்றும் மூன்று வினைச்செயல் தொகுதிகளைக் கொண்ட ஒற்றைப்படிகளிலிருந்து உருவாகின்றன
பல்வேறு நேர்க்கோட்டு பலபடிச் சங்கிலிகளுக்கு இடையே சகப்பிணைப்புகளைக் கொண்டுள்ளன
அவற்றின் பலபடிச் சங்கிலியில் வலிமையான சகப்பிணைப்புகளைக் கொண்டுள்ளன
questions.explanationEn: According to the NEET / textbook answer key (page 319, Q15), option (d) is marked as the incorrect statement.
questions.explanationTa: பாடப்புத்தக விடைக்குறிப்பின்படி (பக்கம் 319, வினா 15) விடை (ஈ) ஆகும்.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: The measure of a drug's margin of safety, defined as the ratio of median lethal dose to median effective dose (LD₅₀ / ED₅₀), is called its
questions.questionTa: ஒரு மருந்தின் பாதுகாப்பைக் குறிக்கும் LD₅₀ மற்றும் ED₅₀ இடையேயான விகிதம் எவ்வாறு அழைக்கப்படுகிறது?
questions.explanationEn: Therapeutic index (LD₅₀ / ED₅₀) measures the safety of a drug; a higher therapeutic index indicates a safer drug.
questions.explanationTa: ஒரு மருந்தின் பாதுகாப்பை அளவிடும் குறியீடு மருத்துவக் குறியீடு (Therapeutic index) எனப்படும்.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Which class of drugs is used for the treatment of stress, anxiety, depression and mental diseases by acting on the central nervous system?
questions.questionTa: மைய நரம்பு மண்டலத்தின் மீது செயல்பட்டு மன அழுத்தம், பதற்றம் மற்றும் மனநோய்களைக் குணப்படுத்தப் பயன்படும் மருந்துகள்
questions.explanationEn: Tranquilizers (such as diazepam/valium, alprazolam, barbiturates) are neurologically active drugs used to treat anxiety and stress.
questions.explanationTa: அமைதிப்படுத்திகள் (Tranquilizers — எ.கா. டயஸிபாம், அல்ப்ரசோலம்) மன அழுத்தம் மற்றும் பதற்றத்தைக் குறைக்கப் பயன்படுகின்றன.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Which of the following is an opioid (narcotic) analgesic used to relieve severe post-operative and cancer pain?
questions.questionTa: அறுவை சிகிச்சைக்குப் பிந்தைய கடுமையான வலியைப் போக்கப் பயன்படும் போதைத் தன்மையுள்ள (Narcotic) வலிநிவாரணி எது?
questions.explanationEn: Morphine and codeine are narcotic (opioid) analgesics that relieve acute pain and induce sleep, whereas aspirin, paracetamol, and ibuprofen are non-narcotic analgesics (NSAIDs).
questions.explanationTa: மார்ஃபின் மற்றும் கோடீன் ஆகியவை போதைத் தன்மையுள்ள (Narcotic) வலிநிவாரணிகளாகும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Which local anaesthetic is an ester of p-aminobenzoic acid (procaine) or amide derivative (lidocaine) that blocks pain without loss of consciousness?
questions.questionTa: சுயநினைவை இழக்கச் செய்யாமல் குறிப்பிட்டப் பகுதியில் மட்டும் உணர்ச்சியை நீக்கும் (Local anaesthetic) மருந்து எது?
questions.explanationEn: Procaine and Lidocaine are local anaesthetics, whereas Propofol, Isoflurane, and Nitrous oxide are general anaesthetics.
questions.explanationTa: புரோகைன் மற்றும் லிடோகைன் ஆகியவை குறிப்பிட்டப் பகுதி மயக்க மருந்துகளாகும் (Local anaesthetics).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Omeprazole and Rabeprazole used to prevent hyperacidity inhibit the proton pump in the stomach, whereas Ranitidine and Cimetidine act by blocking
questions.questionTa: அமில நீக்கிகளான ரானிடிடின் மற்றும் சிமெடிடின் ஆகியவை வயிற்றில் எதனுடைய செயல்பாட்டைத் தடுத்து அமிலச் சுரப்பைக் குறைக்கின்றன?
optionsEn: Histamine interaction with stomach wall receptors
optionsTa: வயிற்றுச் சுவரிலுள்ள ஏற்பிகளுடன் ஹிஸ்டமைன் இடையீடு செய்வதை
questions.explanationEn: Cimetidine and Ranitidine prevent the interaction of histamine with receptors in the stomach wall, reducing acid secretion.
questions.explanationTa: சிமெடிடின் மற்றும் ரானிடிடின் வயிற்றுச் சுவரிலுள்ள ஏற்பிகளுடன் ஹிஸ்டமைன் பிணைவதைத் தடுத்து அமிலச் சுரப்பைக் குறைக்கின்றன.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Dettol is a widely used antiseptic which is a mixture of
questions.questionTa: புரைத்தடுப்பானாகப் பயன்படும் டெட்டால் (Dettol) என்பது எவற்றின் கலவை?
questions.explanationEn: Dettol is an antiseptic mixture of chloroxylenol (4-chloro-3,5-dimethylphenol) and terpineol in a suitable solvent.
questions.explanationTa: டெட்டால் என்பது குளோரோசைலினால் மற்றும் டெர்பினியால் ஆகியவற்றின் கலவையாகும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: What is the composition of Tincture of iodine used on wounds as an antiseptic?
questions.questionTa: காயங்களுக்குப் புரைத்தடுப்பானாகப் பயன்படும் அயோடின் டிங்சர் (Tincture of iodine) என்பது
optionsEn: 2–3% solution of iodine in alcohol–water mixture
questions.explanationEn: Tincture of iodine is a 2–3% solution of elemental iodine in an alcohol–water mixture.
questions.explanationTa: ஆல்கஹால்–நீர் கலவையில் உள்ள 2–3% அயோடின் கரைசல் அயோடின் டிங்சர் எனப்படும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Which of the following is a synthetic progesterone derivative used as an antifertility drug?
questions.questionTa: பின்வருவனவற்றுள் கருத்தடை மருந்தாகப் (Antifertility drug) பயன்படும் தொகுப்பு புரோஜெஸ்டிரோன் பெறுதி எது?
questions.explanationEn: Norethindrone (synthetic progesterone derivative) and ethynylestradiol (novestrol, estrogen derivative) are used in birth control pills as antifertility drugs.
questions.explanationTa: நாரெத்திண்ட்ரோன் மற்றும் நோவெஸ்ட்ரால் (எத்தினைல்எஸ்ட்ராடையால்) ஆகியவை கருத்தடை மாத்திரைகளில் பயன்படுகின்றன.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Which artificial sweetener is unstable at cooking temperature and is therefore restricted to cold foods and soft drinks?
questions.questionTa: சமைக்கும் வெப்பநிலையில் சிதைவடைவதால் குளிர்பானங்கள் மற்றும் குளிர்ந்த உணவுகளில் மட்டும் பயன்படுத்தப்படும் செயற்கை இனிப்புச் சுவையூட்டி எது?
questions.explanationEn: Aspartame (methyl ester of dipeptide formed from aspartic acid and phenylalanine) decomposes at cooking temperatures and is used only in cold foods/drinks.
questions.explanationTa: அஸ்பார்டிக் அமிலம் மற்றும் பினைல்அலனின் ஆகியவற்றிலிருந்து பெறப்படும் அஸ்பார்டேம் சமைக்கும் வெப்பநிலையில் சிதைவடைவதால் குளிர்பானங்களில் மட்டும் பயன்படுகிறது.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Which antioxidants are commonly added to food containing fats and oils to prevent rancidity (oxidative spoilage)?
questions.questionTa: கொழுப்பு மற்றும் எண்ணெய் உணவுப் பொருட்கள் ஆக்சிஜனேற்றமடைந்து கெட்டுப்போவதைத் தடுக்கச் சேர்க்கப்படும் எதிர்ஆக்சிஜனேற்றிகள் (Antioxidants) எவை?
questions.explanationEn: Butylated hydroxytoluene (BHT) and Butylated hydroxyanisole (BHA) are synthetic antioxidants added to fats and butter to prevent oxidative rancidity.
questions.explanationTa: பியூட்டைலேற்றப்பட்ட ஹைட்ராக்சிடொலுயீன் (BHT) மற்றும் பியூட்டைலேற்றப்பட்ட ஹைட்ராக்சிஅனிசோல் (BHA) உணவுப் பொருட்களில் எதிர்ஆக்சிஜனேற்றிகளாகச் சேர்க்கப்படுகின்றன.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Which chemical property of oils and fats is defined as the number of milligrams of KOH required to saponify 1 gram of fat or oil?
questions.questionTa: 1 கிராம் கொழுப்பு அல்லது எண்ணெயை முழுமையாக சோப்பாக்கத் தேவைப்படும் பொட்டாசியம் ஹைட்ராக்சைடின் (KOH) மில்லிகிராம் எண்ணிக்கை எவ்வாறு அழைக்கப்படுகிறது?
questions.explanationEn: Total fatty matter (TFM) assesses soap quality, and saponification value is the mg of KOH needed to saponify 1 g of fat/oil.
questions.explanationTa: 1 கிராம் எண்ணெயை சோப்பாக்கத் தேவைப்படும் KOH-ன் மில்லிகிராம் அளவு சோப்பாக்கல் மதிப்பு எனப்படும் (மேலும் சோப்பின் தரம் TFM மதிப்பால் அறியப்படுகிறது).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) is prepared at 333–343 K and 6–7 atm pressure using Ziegler–Natta catalyst, which is a mixture of
questions.questionTa: உயர் அடர்த்தி பாலித்தீன் (HDPE) தயாரிக்கப் பயன்படும் ஜீக்லர்–நட்டா வினைவேக மாற்றி என்பது எவற்றின் கலவை?
questions.explanationEn: Ziegler–Natta catalyst is a mixture of titanium tetrachloride (TiCl₄) and triethylaluminium, (C₂H₅)₃Al.
questions.explanationTa: ஜீக்லர்–நட்டா வினைவேக மாற்றி என்பது TiCl₄ மற்றும் டிரைஎத்தில்அலுமினியம் ((C₂H₅)₃Al) ஆகியவற்றின் கலவையாகும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: What is the monomer used in the manufacture of Nylon-6?
questions.questionTa: நைலான்-6 தயாரிக்கப் பயன்படும் ஒற்றைப்படி (monomer) எது?
questions.explanationEn: Nylon-6 is obtained by heating caprolactam with water at high temperature (533–543 K).
questions.explanationTa: கேப்ரோலாக்டம் என்ற ஒற்றைப்படியை நீருடன் உயர் வெப்பநிலையில் வெப்பப்படுத்தி நைலான்-6 தயாரிக்கப்படுகிறது.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Vulcanization of natural rubber involves heating natural rubber with 3–5% of ______ at 100–150°C to introduce cross-links.
questions.questionTa: இயற்கை இரப்பரின் இயற்பியல் பண்புகளை மேம்படுத்த அதனை 100–150°C-ல் 3–5% ______ உடன் வெப்பப்படுத்தும் வல்கனீயக்கல் (Vulcanization) முறை பயன்படுகிறது.
questions.explanationEn: Discovered by Charles Goodyear, vulcanization heats natural rubber with 3–5% sulphur to introduce disulphide (−S–S−) cross-links between cis-1,4-polyisoprene chains.
questions.explanationTa: இயற்கை இரப்பரை கந்தகத்துடன் (Sulphur) வெப்பப்படுத்தி டைசல்பைடு (−S–S−) குறுக்குப் பிணைப்புகளை உருவாக்கும் முறை வல்கனீயக்கல் எனப்படும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionEn: Nylon-2-Nylon-6 is a biodegradable polyamide copolymer formed by the condensation of
questions.questionTa: மக்கும் பலபடியான நைலான்-2-நைலான்-6 என்பது எந்த ஒற்றைப்படிகளின் குறுக்கப் பலபடியாக்கலால் உருவாகிறது?
questions.explanationEn: Nylon-2-Nylon-6 is a biodegradable copolymer prepared by alternating polyamide condensation of glycine (H₂N–CH₂–COOH) and ε-aminocaproic acid (H₂N–(CH₂)₅–COOH).
questions.explanationTa: கிளைசீன் (H₂N–CH₂–COOH) மற்றும் ε-அமினோகேப்ராயிக் அமிலம் (H₂N–(CH₂)₅–COOH) ஆகியவற்றின் குறுக்கப் பலபடியாக்கலால் நைலான்-2-நைலான்-6 என்ற மக்கும் பலபடி உருவாகிறது.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Match the phrasal verbs with their meanings (p. 7):
1) draw up - A) faint / lose consciousness
2) pass out - B) rely on / depend on
3) bank on - C) come to a halt / stop (a vehicle)
4) stand by - D) support / remain loyal
questions.explanationEn: draw up = stop a vehicle ('we drew up at a large red-roofed villa'); pass out = faint; bank on = rely on; stand by = support.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Choose the correct prefix and suffix for the root word 'manage':
questions.explanationEn: Prefix: 'mis-' -> mismanage; Suffix: '-ment' / '-er' / '-able' -> management / manager / manageable.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Choose the correct prefix for the word 'fertile':
questions.explanationEn: Prefix 'in-' is added to 'fertile' to form 'infertile' (Suffix: fertility).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Fill in the blank with the correct tense form (p. 11): 'Everyone _______ when the earthquake hit the small town.'
questions.explanationEn: Past Continuous ('was sleeping') is used for an ongoing past action interrupted by another past event ('hit').
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Fill in the blank with the correct tense form (p. 11): 'My mother was tired yesterday because she _______ well the night before.'
questions.explanationEn: Past Perfect ('had not slept') is used for an action completed before another past state ('was tired yesterday').
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Fill in the blank with the correct tense form (p. 12): 'Scientists predict that by 2050, man _______ on Mars.'
questions.explanationEn: Future Perfect ('will have landed') is used with 'by + future time (by 2050)'.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Fill in the blank with a suitable modal auxiliary (p. 14): 'Poonam _______ not catch the bus yesterday.'
questions.explanationEn: 'Could' is the past form of 'can' used here to indicate past inability ('yesterday').
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Complete the sentence with a modal using the clue given (p. 14): 'Had the doctor come in time, he _______ have saved the patient.' (probability)
questions.explanationEn: In Type 3 Conditional ('Had + S + V3'), 'would have / could have + V3' is used in the main clause.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Choose the correct indirect speech for: Satya said, 'I have completed my work.'
optionsEn: a) Satya said that she has completed her work.
b) Satya said that she had completed her work.
c) Satya said that I had completed my work.
d) Satya told that she completed her work.
questions.explanationEn: Present Perfect ('have completed') changes to Past Perfect ('had completed') in reported speech.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: In 'Two Gentlemen of Verona', how old were the two brothers Nicola and Jacopo, and what was their sister Lucia suffering from?
optionsEn: a) Nicola 13, Jacopo 12; Tuberculosis of the spine
b) Nicola 12, Jacopo 13; Malignant tumour of the bone
questions.explanationEn: Nicola, the elder, was 13; Jacopo was nearly 12. Their sister Lucia (aged 20) suffered from tuberculosis of the spine at a hospital in Poleta (30 km from Verona).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Identify the figure of speech in the line: 'A little wicked wicket gate.' (The Castle, p. 22)
questions.explanationEn: 'Wicked' is a human moral quality attributed to an inanimate 'wicket gate' (Personification). Also contains alliteration (wicked-wicket).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Identify the figure of speech used in the line: 'Grew thin and treacherous as air.' (The Castle, p. 22)
questions.explanationEn: The tunnelled stone maze is compared to air using 'as' (Simile).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Identify the figure of speech in the line: 'How can this shameful tale be told?' (The Castle, p. 22)
questions.explanationEn: A question asked for dramatic effect rather than to get an answer is a Rhetorical Question (Interrogation).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: In the poem 'The Castle', who let the enemies into the famous citadel and what was their 'only enemy'?
optionsEn: c) The mowers in the hay; starvation
questions.explanationEn: 'The wizened warder let them through... Our only enemy was gold, And we had no arms to fight it with.'
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: In Leo Tolstoy's 'God Sees the Truth, But Waits', where did Ivan Dmitrich Aksionov live, how many years did he spend in Siberia, and which book did he buy in prison?
optionsEn: a) Vladimir; 26 years; The Lives of the Saints
b) Ryazan; 20 years; War and Peace
c) Nizhny; 26 years; The Pilgrim's Progress
questions.explanationEn: Aksionov lived in Vladimir, was accused of murdering a merchant from Ryazan, spent 26 years in Siberia, and bought 'The Lives of the Saints' by making boots.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: God Sees the Truth, But Waits (p. 24-30)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: In 'God Sees the Truth, But Waits', what do the Russian terms 'samovar' and 'troika' refer to?
optionsEn: a) A musical instrument; a snow sledge
b) A Russian metal urn for making tea; a cart pulled by a team of three horses
c) A leather whip; a prison church
d) A silver coin; a fur coat
questions.explanationEn: Glossary (p. 30): 'samovar' is a Russian metal urn for making tea; 'troika' is a cart pulled by a team of three horses.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: God Sees the Truth, But Waits - Glossary (p. 30)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Find out the synonym of the underlined word: 'But because the best manner of making it is the subject of violent disputes.'
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Vocabulary (p. 39): 'disputes' means conflicts or arguments.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: A Nice Cup of Tea - Synonyms (p. 39)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Find out the synonym of the underlined word: '...tea is one of the mainstays of civilization in the country.'
optionsEn: a) a society in an advanced state of social development
b) a society that has slow progress
c) a society that has no progress
d) a society in an average state of social development
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Vocabulary (p. 39): 'civilization' means a society in an advanced state of social development.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: A Nice Cup of Tea - Synonyms (p. 39)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Find out the synonym of the underlined word: '...that they only drink it in order to be warmed and stimulated.'
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Vocabulary (p. 39): 'stimulated' means motivated / excited / energized.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: A Nice Cup of Tea - Synonyms (p. 39)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Find out the synonym of the underlined word: '...under the spout to catch the stray leaves.'
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Vocabulary (p. 39): 'stray' leaves means loose / separated leaves.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: A Nice Cup of Tea - Synonyms (p. 39)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Find out the synonym of the underlined word: 'One is liable to put in too much milk.'
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Vocabulary (p. 39): 'liable' means likely.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: A Nice Cup of Tea - Synonyms (p. 39)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Find out the antonym of the underlined word: '...which are not to be despised.'
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Vocabulary (p. 39): 'despised' means hated; its antonym is 'liked' (or respected).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: A Nice Cup of Tea - Antonyms (p. 39)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Find out the antonym of the underlined word: 'One does not feel wise, braver or more optimistic.'
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Vocabulary (p. 39): The antonym of 'optimistic' (hopeful) is 'pessimistic'.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: A Nice Cup of Tea - Antonyms (p. 39)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Find out the antonym of the underlined word: 'Not the flat, shallow type...'
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Vocabulary (p. 39): The antonym of 'shallow' is 'deep'.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: A Nice Cup of Tea - Antonyms (p. 39)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Find out the antonym of the underlined word: 'Predicting the arrival of visitors...'
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Vocabulary (p. 39): The antonym of 'arrival' is 'departure'.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: A Nice Cup of Tea - Antonyms (p. 39)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Find out the antonym of the underlined word: '...but they are sufficient to show how subtilized the whole business has become.'
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Vocabulary (p. 39): The antonym of 'sufficient' is 'inadequate'.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: A Nice Cup of Tea - Antonyms (p. 39)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: What is the real name of George Orwell, and how many golden rules does he list in his essay 'A Nice Cup of Tea'?
optionsEn: a) Eric Arthur Blair; 11 golden rules
b) Archibald Joseph Cronin; 10 golden rules
c) Alfred George Gardiner; 12 golden rules
questions.explanationEn: Eric Arthur Blair (pen name George Orwell), author of Animal Farm and Nineteen Eighty-Four, lists 11 golden rules for making tea.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: A Nice Cup of Tea - George Orwell (p. 35-37)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: According to George Orwell, which teapot material produces the best tea, and how many heaped teaspoons of tea are right for a pot holding a quart?
optionsEn: a) China or earthenware; six heaped teaspoons
b) Silver or Britannia ware; four heaped teaspoons
questions.explanationEn: The teapot should be made of china or earthenware (pewter is not so bad, silver/enamel are worse). A pot holding a quart needs six heaped teaspoons.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Complete the sentences with the correct prepositions (p. 45):
1) Yuvan has been studying well _______ childhood.
2) There was a skirmish _______ my brother and sister.
questions.explanationEn: 'Since' is used for a point in time (childhood); 'between' is used for two nouns connected by 'and' (my brother and sister).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Fill in the blanks with suitable prepositional phrases (p. 46):
1) Many tourists visited Ooty _______ heavy rains.
2) _______ rain, take an umbrella.
optionsEn: a) on account of, Instead of
b) in spite of, In case of
c) in favour of, On behalf of
d) according to, On the whole
questions.explanationEn: 'in spite of' expresses contrast (despite heavy rains); 'in case of' expresses condition/precaution.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Choose the appropriate linkers (p. 48):
1) _______ you register your name, you cannot participate in the competitions.
2) My brother will certainly clear GRE; _______ he works very hard.
questions.explanationEn: 'Unless' means 'if not'; 'for' is a coordinating conjunction of reason/cause (meaning 'because').
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Fill in the blank with the appropriate correlative conjunction (p. 48): 'She is _______ an understanding person _______ everybody likes to be with her.'
questions.explanationEn: 'Such + a/an + adjective + noun + that' is the correct correlative structure ('such an understanding person that...').
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Identify the figure of speech in the opening lines of 'Our Casuarina Tree':
'LIKE a huge Python, winding round and round
The rugged trunk, indented deep with scars'
questions.explanationEn: Book Back (p. 56): Describing the vine in animal terms (as a python) using 'Like' is both Zoomorphism and Simile.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: Our Casuarina Tree by Toru Dutt (p. 56)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Identify the figure of speech in: 'What is that dirge-like murmur that I hear / Like the sea breaking on a shingle-beach? / It is the tree's lament, an eerie speech'
questions.explanationEn: 'dirge-like' and 'Like the sea' are Similes; 'the tree's lament, an eerie speech' attributes human weeping/speech to the tree (Personification).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: Our Casuarina Tree by Toru Dutt (p. 56)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: In 'Our Casuarina Tree', what sits 'statue-like alone' watching the sunrise on the tree's crest in winter, and which trees did Wordsworth sanctify that Toru Dutt alludes to?
optionsEn: a) A gray baboon; the yew trees of Borrowdale
b) A kokila bird; the oak trees of France
c) A python; the pine trees of Italy
d) A water-wraith; the banyan trees of Bengal
questions.explanationEn: A gray baboon sits statue-like alone on its crest while its puny offspring leap on lower boughs. Toru Dutt alludes to the deathless yew trees in Borrowdale (Wordsworth).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: In 'Life of Pi', how many days did Pi Patel survive in the Pacific Ocean, what was the name of the ship that sank, and how many days of water rations did he find?
optionsEn: a) 227 days; Tsimtsum; 124 days of water rations
b) 124 days; Panama; 227 days of water rations
c) 300 days; Titanic; 100 days of water rations
d) 227 days; Pondicherry; 500 days of water rations
questions.explanationEn: Pi survived 227 days after the shipwreck of 'Tsimtsum'. He drank four 500ml cans (2 litres) of water and calculated he had water rations to last 124 days.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: Life of Pi by Yann Martel (p. 59-64)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Match the words from 'Life of Pi' with their meanings (p. 64):
1) flotsam - A) death due to lack of oxygen
2) conundrum - B) a humble request / prayer
3) asphyxiation - C) debris floating in a river or sea
4) supplication - D) a riddle / puzzling question
questions.explanationEn: Glossary (p. 64): flotsam = floating debris; conundrum = a riddle; asphyxiation = death due to lack of oxygen; supplication = a humble request/prayer.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Spot the words from the lesson 'In Celebration of Being Alive' which mean the same as:
1) hijacked (para 8)
2) serious (para 10)
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Vocabulary (p. 71): hijacked (para 8) = 'commandeered'; serious (para 10) = 'severe' (Also: profession = career, sorrowful = gloomy, decency = nobility, destiny = fate, significant = important).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: In Celebration of Being Alive - Synonyms (p. 71)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Spot the words from the lesson 'In Celebration of Being Alive' opposite in meaning to:
1) rare (para 1)
2) fearful (para 8)
3) benign (para 11)
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Antonyms (p. 71): rare x prevalent; primitive x sophisticated; fiction x fact; fearful x intrepid; benign x malignant; diffidence x confidence; boredom x amusement; criticize x appreciate.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: In Celebration of Being Alive - Antonyms (p. 71)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Fill in the blanks with the words from the text (p. 72): 'The _______ warriors of the Spartan Army marched into battle, while the tyres of the car got _______ when it rolled over rusted nails.'
questions.explanationEn: 'intrepid' means bold and daring; 'perforated' means torn and damaged with holes.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: In Celebration of Being Alive - Fill in the blanks (p. 72)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Form a phrase with each of the following pairs of nouns (p. 72) on the model of 'fibre + tissue = fibrous tissue':
1) muscle + pain
2) skeleton + system
3) digestion + enzymes
optionsEn: a) muscular pain, skeletal system, digestive enzymes
b) muscly pain, skeletonic system, digested enzymes
c) muscularly pain, skeletal system, digestion enzymes
d) muscle pain, bone system, digesting enzymes
questions.explanationEn: muscle -> muscular pain; skeleton -> skeletal system; nerve -> nervous disorder; digestion -> digestive enzymes; surgery -> surgical instruments; agony -> agonizing experience.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: Word Formation - Noun + Noun to Adj + Noun (p. 72)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Spot the error and choose the correct sentence for: 'The Boss had full confidence on his Manager for successful completion of the project.' (p. 73)
optionsEn: a) The Boss had full confidence in his Manager for the successful completion of the project.
b) The Boss had full confidence at his Manager for successful completion of the project.
c) The Boss had full confident on his Manager for successful completion.
d) The Boss have full confidence on his Manager.
questions.explanationEn: The noun 'confidence' takes the preposition 'in' (confidence in someone), not 'on'. Similarly: 'hoped for complete recovery' (not hoped of), 'suffering from' (not suffering with).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Identify the correct version of the erroneous sentence from page 73: 'My grandfather is well-known in the village for his nobel deeds.'
optionsEn: a) My grandfather is well-known in the village for his noble deeds.
b) My grandfather are well-known in the village for his nobel deeds.
c) My grandfather is well-known at the village for his nobel deeds.
d) My grandfather is well-known in the village for his nobility deeds.
questions.explanationEn: Spelling/Homophone error: 'noble' (worthy/moral) should be used instead of 'nobel'. Similarly on p. 73: 'dream career' instead of 'dream carrier', and 'evening meal' instead of 'evening meals'.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Change into Passive Voice (p. 77): 'Who taught her Computer Science?'
optionsEn: a) By whom was she taught Computer Science?
b) Who was taught Computer Science by her?
c) By whom she was taught Computer Science?
d) Whom was she taught Computer Science?
questions.explanationEn: In interrogative passive voice, 'Who' becomes 'By whom' followed by auxiliary verb + subject + past participle ('By whom was she taught Computer Science?').
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Change into Passive Voice (p. 77): 'One should keep one's promise.'
optionsEn: a) One's promise should be kept by one.
b) Promises should be kept. / A promise should be kept.
c) Let one's promise be kept.
d) Promise is kept by one.
questions.explanationEn: Indefinite subjects like 'one', 'someone', 'people' are omitted in the passive voice: 'A promise should be kept.'
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Choose the correct question tag for the following sentences (p. 81):
1) Let's clean the shelves this weekend, _______?
2) My mother rarely travels by bus, _______?
questions.explanationEn: Sentences beginning with 'Let's' take 'shall we?'. Words like 'rarely, hardly, scarcely, seldom' are negative in meaning and take a positive tag ('does she?').
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Choose the correct question tag for the following sentences (p. 81):
1) I am always the winner, _______?
2) Somebody must bell the cat, _______?
questions.explanationEn: Affirmative 'I am' takes the contracted tag 'aren't I?'. Indefinite pronouns like 'Somebody, Everyone, Nobody' take the plural pronoun 'they' in the tag ('mustn't they?').
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Match the age groups with the single words depicting them (Do You Know box, p. 88):
1) 40–49 years - A) Quinquagenarian
2) 50–59 years - B) Septuagenarian
3) 70–79 years - C) Quadragenarian
4) 80–89 years - D) Octogenarian
questions.explanationEn: 10-19: denarian; 20-29: vicenarian; 30-39: tricenarian; 40-49: quadragenarian; 50-59: quinquagenarian; 60-69: sexagenarian; 70-79: septuagenarian; 80-89: octogenarian; 90-99: nonagenarian; 100+: centenarian.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
In Shakespeare's 'All the World's a Stage' (from As You Like It, spoken by Jaques), identify the figures of speech in:
1) 'All the world's a stage'
2) 'And shining morning face, creeping like snail'
3) 'Seeking the bubble reputation'
questions.explanationEn: 'All the world's a stage' and 'Seeking the bubble reputation' are Metaphors; 'creeping like snail' (and 'bearded like the pard', 'sighing like furnace') are Similes.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: All the World's a Stage by William Shakespeare (p. 88-92)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: In 'All the World's a Stage', which stage of man's life is described as 'In fair round belly with good capon lin'd, With eyes severe and beard of formal cut, Full of wise saws and modern instances'?
optionsEn: a) The fourth stage - The Soldier
b) The fifth stage - The Justice (Judge)
c) The sixth stage - The lean and slipper'd pantaloon
d) The seventh stage - Second childishness
questions.explanationEn: The fifth stage is 'the justice' (judge). 'Saws' means sayings/proverbs; 'capon' means fat chicken.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Match the idioms from 'The Hour of Truth' with their meanings (p. 109):
1) save one's skin - A) a sudden unexpected event or news
2) a bolt out of a clear sky - B) viewed with suspicion and distrust
3) have the whip hand - C) to protect oneself from difficulty
4) under a cloud - D) to be the most powerful
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Idioms (p. 109): save one's skin = protect oneself from difficulty; make both ends meet = manage expenses within income; a bolt out of a clear sky = sudden unexpected event; have the whip hand = be the most powerful; under a cloud = viewed with suspicion.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: In Percival Wilde's one-act play 'The Hour of Truth', what was Robert Baldwin's weekly salary at Gresham's bank, how much bribe did John Gresham offer him to say 'I don't remember', and who offered Baldwin a job at the Third National Bank?
optionsEn: a) 60 dollars a week; 100,000 dollars; Mr. Marshall
b) 100 dollars a week; 50,000 dollars; Mr. Donovan
c) 60 dollars a week; 10,000 dollars; Mr. Gresham
d) 50 dollars a week; 100,000 dollars; Mr. Donovan
questions.explanationEn: Baldwin earned 60 dollars a week, Gresham offered him a hundred thousand dollars in thousand-dollar bills, and Mr. Marshall (President of the Third National) offered him a position after Gresham confessed.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

sources.reference: The Hour of Truth by Percival Wilde (p. 95-105)

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Match the idioms from 'The Summit' with their meanings (p. 117):
1) wait for the dust to settle - A) to have made all preparations needed / be well organized
2) get all your ducks in a row - B) to think carefully about all relevant facts/figures before doing something
3) fetch and carry - C) to wait for a situation to become clear or certain
4) do the math - D) to do a lot of little jobs for somebody
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Idioms (p. 117): wait for the dust to settle = wait for a situation to become clear; have all your ducks in a row = be well organized; fetch and carry = do a lot of little jobs; do the math = calculate/think carefully; round the corner = very near.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Fill in the blanks with the right idioms (p. 117):
1) The chairman introduced an interactive session to _______.
2) Our headmistress not only promised an excursion, but also announced a holiday on return. It was like _______.
optionsEn: a) break the ice, the icing on the cake
b) the icing on the cake, break the ice
c) do the math, fetch and carry
d) wait for the dust to settle, round the corner
questions.explanationEn: 'break the ice' = make people more relaxed at the beginning of a meeting; 'the icing on the cake' = something extra that makes a good situation even better.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Match the travel-related phrasal verbs with their meanings (p. 118):
1) see off - A) stay at a place for a short period when travelling to another destination
2) stop over - B) go to station or airport to say goodbye to someone
3) set off - C) arrive and register at airport or hotel
4) check in - D) start a journey
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Phrasal Verbs (p. 118): see off = say goodbye at station/airport; stop over = halt briefly on a journey; set off = start a journey; check in = register at hotel/airport; check out = pay bill when leaving hotel.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Match the compound words with their definitions (p. 118):
1) ice-berg - A) specially prepared flat surface of ice for skating
2) ice-cap - B) an extremely large mass of ice floating in the sea
3) ice-floe - C) a layer of ice permanently covering parts of the earth (North/South Poles)
4) ice-rink - D) a large area of ice floating in the sea
questions.explanationEn: Book Back Compound Words (p. 118): ice-berg, ice-cap, ice-floe, ice-sheet, ice-rink.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Match the 'snow' compound words with their semantic fields (p. 119):
1) snow-board - A) Weather
2) snow-mobile - B) Geography
3) snow-storm - C) Sports
4) snow-belt - D) Transportation
questions.explanationEn: snow-board -> Sports; snow-mobile -> Transportation; snow-chains -> Machinery; snow-storm -> Weather; snow-bird -> Travel; snow-belt -> Geography.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: In 'The Summit', at what time on May 29, 1953 did Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay reach the top of Mt. Everest, and what did they place in the snow as offerings?
optionsEn: a) 11.30 a.m.; Tenzing placed chocolate, biscuits, and lollies; Hillary placed a small crucifix given by Colonel Hunt
b) 9.00 a.m.; Tenzing placed a prayer flag; Hillary placed an ice-axe
c) 2.00 p.m.; Tenzing placed sardines; Hillary placed oxygen bottles
d) 6.30 a.m.; Tenzing placed flowers; Hillary placed a Bible
questions.explanationEn: They crawled out at 6.30 a.m., reached the South Peak at 9 a.m., and stood on the summit at 11.30 a.m. Tenzing placed a bar of chocolate, a packet of biscuits, and lollies; Hillary placed a crucifix given by Colonel John Hunt.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Fill in the blanks with the correct verb forms in Conditional Clauses (p. 124-125):
1) If I _______ (be) a spider, I _______ (weave) webs.
2) If I had won the lottery, I _______ (donate) relief materials for the flood victims.
optionsEn: a) was, will weave | will donate
b) were, would weave | would have donated
c) am, would weave | had donated
questions.explanationEn: 1) Type II (Hypothetical/Unreal): 'If I were..., I would weave'. 2) Type III (Impossible past): 'If I had won..., I would have donated'.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: Do as directed (p. 219): 'Besides being a singer, she is also a dancer.' (Rewrite as a compound sentence)
optionsEn: a) She is not only a singer, but also a dancer.
b) Though she is a singer, she is a dancer.
c) She is a singer who dances well.
d) Being a singer, she dances.
questions.explanationEn: Simple ('Besides being...') transforms into Compound using correlative conjunctions 'not only... but also' or 'and'.

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Identify the figures of speech in the following lines from 'Ulysses' (p. 132):
1) 'Yet all experience is an arch wherethro' / Gleams that untravell'd world'
2) 'To follow knowledge like a sinking star'
3) 'There lies the port; the vessel puffs her sail'
questions.explanationEn: 'experience is an arch' = Metaphor; 'like a sinking star' = Simile; 'the vessel puffs her sail' (and 'the deep moans round with many voices') = Personification.

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: In Ki. Rajanarayanan's 'The Chair' (translated by Pritham K. Chakravarthy from 'Naarkaali'), which wood did Grandmother, Maamanaar, and Pedanna suggest for making the chair, and what colour did the elder sister finally recommend?
optionsEn: a) Grandmother: Teak; Maamanaar: Neem; Pedanna: Poovarasu; Elder sister: Black wood (like sesame oilcake / ripe sugarcane)
b) Grandmother: Neem; Maamanaar: Teak; Pedanna: Rosewood; Elder sister: Red wood
c) Grandmother: Poovarasu; Maamanaar: Sandalwood; Pedanna: Teak; Elder sister: White wood
d) Grandmother: Bamboo; Maamanaar: Neem; Pedanna: Teak; Elder sister: Brown wood
questions.explanationEn: Grandmother suggested Teak (light and sturdy); Maamanaar suggested Neem (keeps body cool); Pedanna suggested Poovarasu (fine-grained, without knots); Elder sister suggested dark/black wood like ripe sugarcane or sesame oilcake.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Identify the grammatical function of the underlined non-finite verbs (p. 155) and spot the error in (3):
1) 'Jumping is fun.'
2) 'The dancing parrots entertained the crowd.'
3) Spot the error: 'She made me to cry.' (p. 221)
optionsEn: a) 1-Gerund, 2-Present Participle (Adjective), 3-'She made me cry' (bare infinitive after 'make')
questions.explanationEn: 'Jumping' is a Gerund (verbal noun acting as subject); 'dancing' modifies 'parrots' so it is a Present Participle; after causative verbs like 'make, let, bid', a bare infinitive without 'to' is used ('She made me cry').
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Identify the correct forms of the erroneous sentences from page 222:
1) 'Oxygen is more heavier than hydrogen.'
2) 'Faster you run, sooner you get tired.'
3) 'Of the two sisters, Helen is the prettiest.'
optionsEn: a) 1-Oxygen is heavier than hydrogen. | 2-The faster you run, the sooner you get tired. | 3-Of the two sisters, Helen is the prettier.
b) 1-Oxygen is most heaviest. | 2-Fastest you run, soonest you get tired. | 3-Of the two sisters, Helen is pretty.
c) 1-Oxygen is heavier to hydrogen. | 2-More faster you run, more sooner you get tired. | 3-Helen is prettiest of two.
d) No error in any of the sentences.
questions.explanationEn: 1) Avoid double comparatives ('more heavier' -> 'heavier'). 2) Parallel comparatives require 'The... the...' ('The faster..., the sooner...'). 3) When comparing two persons/things ('Of the two'), use Comparative ('the prettier'), not Superlative.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

3) 'Let him have lazy days seeking his deeper motives.'

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn: According to the Functional Stress rule on page 181, when words like 'contract, conduct, object, present, rebel, record' are used as a NOUN vs as a VERB, where does the primary stress fall?
optionsEn: a) First syllable for Noun ('con-tract); Second syllable for Verb (con-'tract)
b) Second syllable for Noun (con-'tract); First syllable for Verb ('con-tract)
c) Both syllables are equally stressed in both Noun and Verb
d) Stress changes only in American English
questions.explanationEn: Book Back (p. 181): Usually, when the first syllable is stressed ('contract, 'conduct, 'object), the word is a Noun; when the second syllable is stressed (con'tract, con'duct, ob'ject), it is a Verb.

questions.subject: English
questions.questionEn:
Choose the correct verb forms to complete the sentences (p. 187):
1) Neither Lekha nor Leela _______ (has/have) been selected.
2) Every man, woman and child _______ (was/were) happy.
3) One of the machines _______ (is/are) defective.
questions.explanationEn: 1) Two singular subjects joined by 'neither...nor' take a singular verb ('has'). 2) Nouns preceded by 'Every' or 'Each' take a singular verb ('was'). 3) 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb ('is').
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.questionEn:
Identify the corrected versions of the following sentences from page 188:
1) 'Abdul as well as Karim deserve praise.'
2) 'Neither Veena nor her sisters has been informed.'
3) 'Sixty miles are a long distance.'
optionsEn: a) 1-deserves, 2-have been informed, 3-is a long distance
c) 1-deserves, 2-has been informed, 3-are a long distance
d) 1-deserve, 2-have been informed, 3-is a long distance
questions.explanationEn: 1) With 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('Abdul... deserves'). 2) With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject ('her sisters have'). 3) Units of distance/money/time as a single whole take a singular verb ('Sixty miles is').
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.questionEn: In 'Incident of the French Camp', what does 'flag-bird' refer to, who was Napoleon's army-leader at Ratisbon, and what were the young soldier's last words?

b) A white dove; Duke of Wellington; 'We've got you Ratisbon!'
c) A falcon; General Charles; 'Long live the Emperor!'
d) The Austrian eagle; Marshal Lannes; 'I am wounded, Sire!'
questions.explanationEn: 'flag-bird' refers to the imperial eagle on the French flag. Lannes (Duke of Montebello) was the Marshal. When Napoleon said 'You're wounded!', the boy's pride was touched to the quick and he replied, 'Nay... I'm killed, Sire!' and fell dead smiling.

Mr. Caesar was a specialist visiting about rose trees.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: The speed of light in an isotropic medium depends on,
questions.questionTa: திசையொப்பு பண்பினைப் பெற்ற (Isotropic) ஊடகத்தின் வழியே செல்லும் ஒளியின் வேகம், பின்வருவனவற்றுள் எதனைச் சார்ந்துள்ளது?
optionsEn: the motion of the source w.r.t medium
questions.explanationEn: In an isotropic medium, refractive index n depends on wavelength (v = c/n), so speed of light depends on its wavelength.
questions.explanationTa: திசையொப்பு ஊடகத்தில் ஒளிவிலகல் எண் n அலைநீளத்தைச் சார்ந்தது (v = c/n). எனவே ஒளியின் வேகம் அதன் அலைநீளத்தைச் சார்ந்துள்ளது.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: A rod of length 10 cm lies along the principal axis of a concave mirror of focal length 10 cm in such a way that its end closer to the pole is 20 cm away from the mirror. The length of the image is, (AIPMT Main 2012)
questions.questionTa: 10 cm நீளமுடைய தண்டு ஒன்று, 10 cm குவியத்தூரம் கொண்ட குழிஆடியின் முதன்மை அச்சில் வைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. தண்டின் ஒரு முனை குழிஆடியின் முனையிலிருந்து 20 cm தொலைவில் இருந்தால், கிடைக்கும் பிம்பத்தின் நீளம் என்ன? (AIPMT 2012)
questions.explanationEn: Near end u₁ = −20 cm (= 2f) ⇒ v₁ = −20 cm. Far end u₂ = −30 cm, f = −10 cm ⇒ v₂ = −15 cm. Image length = |v₁ − v₂| = 5 cm.
questions.explanationTa: அருகிலுள்ள முனை u₁ = −20 cm ⇒ v₁ = −20 cm. மறுமுனை u₂ = −30 cm, f = −10 cm ⇒ v₂ = −15 cm. பிம்பத்தின் நீளம் = 20 − 15 = 5 cm.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: An object is placed in front of a convex mirror of focal length of f and the maximum and minimum distance of an object from the mirror such that the image formed is real and magnified. (JEE Main 2009)
questions.questionTa: குவியத்தூரம் f கொண்ட குவிஆடியின் முன்பாகப் பொருளொன்று வைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. பெரிதாக்கப்பட்ட மெய் பிம்பம் கிடைக்க வேண்டுமெனில், குவிஆடியிலிருந்து பொருளை வைக்க வேண்டிய பெரும மற்றும் சிறுமத் தொலைவுகள் யாவை? (JEE Main 2009)
questions.explanationEn: A convex mirror always forms a virtual and diminished image for any real object position.
questions.explanationTa: குவிஆடி எப்போதும் மெய்ப்பொருளுக்கு சிறிய மாயப் பிம்பத்தையே உருவாக்கும். எனவே மேற்கண்ட எதுவுமில்லை.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: For light incident from air on a slab of refractive index 2, the maximum possible angle of refraction is,
questions.questionTa: காற்றிலிருந்து, ஒளிவிலகல் எண் 2 கொண்ட கண்ணாடிப் பட்டகத்தின் மீது ஒளி விழுகிறது எனில், சாத்தியமான பெரும விலகுகோணத்தின் மதிப்பு என்ன?
questions.explanationEn: By Snell's law, sin r_max = sin 90° / 2 = 1/2 ⇒ r_max = 30°.
questions.explanationTa: ஸ்னெல் விதிப்படி பெரும விலகுகோணத்திற்கு i = 90° ⇒ sin r = 1/2 ⇒ r = 30°.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: If the velocity and wavelength of light in air is Vₐ and λₐ and that in water is V_w and λ_w, then the refractive index of water is,
questions.questionTa: காற்றில், ஒளியின் திசைவேகம் மற்றும் அலைநீளம் முறையே Vₐ மற்றும் λₐ. இதே போன்று தண்ணீரில் V_w மற்றும் λ_w எனில், தண்ணீரின் ஒளிவிலகல் எண் என்ன?
questions.explanationEn: Refractive index of water n = speed of light in air (Vₐ) / speed of light in water (V_w).
questions.explanationTa: தண்ணீரின் ஒளிவிலகல் எண் n = Vₐ / V_w.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: Stars twinkle due to,

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: When a biconvex lens of glass having refractive index 1.47 is dipped in a liquid, it acts as a plane sheet of glass. This implies that the liquid must have refractive index,
questions.questionTa: ஒளிவிலகல் எண் 1.47 கொண்ட இருபுற குவிலென்ஸ் ஒன்று திரவம் ஒன்றில் மூழ்கி, சமதள கண்ணாடித் தகடு போன்று செயல்படுகிறது எனில், திரவத்தின் ஒளிவிலகல் எண் எவ்வாறு இருக்க வேண்டும்?
questions.explanationEn: For lens to act as a plane sheet, P = 1/f = 0 ⇒ refractive index of liquid must equal that of glass (1.47).
questions.explanationTa: சமதள கண்ணாடித் தகடு போல் செயல்பட P = 0 ஆக இருக்க வேண்டும்; எனவே திரவத்தின் ஒளிவிலகல் எண் கண்ணாடிக்குச் சமமாக (1.47) இருக்க வேண்டும்.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: The radius of curvature of curved surface at a thin planoconvex lens is 10 cm and the refractive index is 1.5. If the plane surface is silvered, then the focal length will be,
questions.questionTa: தட்டைக் குவிலென்ஸ் ஒன்றின் வளைவுப்பரப்பின் வளைவு ஆரம் 10 cm. மேலும், அதன் ஒளிவிலகல் எண் 1.5. குவிலென்சின் தட்டைப்பரப்பின் மீது வெள்ளி பூசப்பட்டால் அதன் குவியத்தூரம்

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: An air bubble in glass slab of refractive index 1.5 (near normal incidence) is 5 cm deep when viewed from one surface and 3 cm deep when viewed from the opposite face. The thickness of the slab is,
questions.questionTa: ஒளிவிலகல் எண் 1.5 கொண்ட கண்ணாடிப் பட்டகம் ஒன்றினுள் காற்றுக் குமிழ் ஒன்று உள்ளது. ஒரு பக்கத்திலிருந்து பார்க்கும்போது 5 cm ஆழத்திலும், மறுபக்கம் வழியாகப் பார்க்கும்போது 3 cm ஆழத்திலும் உள்ளது எனில், கண்ணாடிப் பட்டகத்தின் தடிமன் என்ன?
questions.explanationEn: Real thickness d = n × (d'₁ + d'₂) = 1.5 × (5 + 3) = 12 cm.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: A ray of light travelling in a transparent medium of refractive index n falls, on a surface separating the medium from air at an angle of incidence of 45°. The ray can undergo total internal reflection for the following n,
questions.questionTa: ஒளிவிலகல் எண் n கொண்ட ஒளிபுகும் ஊடகத்தின் வழியே செல்லும் ஒளிக்கதிர், காற்றிலிருந்து இந்த ஊடகத்தைப் பிரிக்கும் தளத்தின் மீது 45° கோணத்தில் விழுந்து முழு அக எதிரொளிப்பு அடைகிறது எனில், n இன் மதிப்பு என்ன?

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: The angle of deviation produced by a plane mirror when the angle of incidence is i is given by,

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: The relation between focal length (f) and radius of curvature (R) of a spherical mirror is,

questions.explanationEn: For spherical mirrors, focal length f = R / 2 (or R = 2f).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: In Fizeau's method to determine the speed of light, the toothed wheel had N teeth and N cuts of equal widths. The speed of light c in terms of distance d and angular speed ω is,
questions.questionTa: ஒளியின் வேகத்தைக் கண்டறியும் ஃபிஸீயு (Fizeau) முறையில், N பற்கள் மற்றும் N இடைவெளிகள் கொண்ட சக்கரத்தின் கோணத் திசைவேகம் ω மற்றும் ஆடியின் தொலைவு d எனில், ஒளியின் வேகம் c என்பது,
questions.explanationEn: Time t = 2d/c = π/(Nω) ⇒ c = 2dNω / π.
questions.explanationTa: t = 2d/c = π/(Nω) என்பதால் ஒளியின் திசைவேகம் c = 2dNω / π.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: If light travels a distance d inside a medium of refractive index n, the equivalent optical path d' in vacuum is,

questions.explanationEn: Optical path d' = n · d.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: The refractive index of diamond and its critical angle are approximately,
questions.questionTa: வைரத்தின் ஒளிவிலகல் எண் மற்றும் அதன் மாறுநிலைக் கோணம் தோராயமாக முறையே,
questions.explanationEn: Diamond has refractive index 2.417 and critical angle 24.4°.
questions.explanationTa: வைரத்தின் ஒளிவிலகல் எண் 2.417 மற்றும் அதன் மாறுநிலைக் கோணம் 24.4° ஆகும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: The radius of the circular illumination in Snell's window when viewed from a depth d in a liquid of refractive index n is,
questions.questionTa: ஒளிவிலகல் எண் n கொண்ட திரவத்தில் d ஆழத்திலிருந்து பார்க்கும்போது தெரியும் ஸ்னெல் சாளரத்தின் (Snell's window) வட்ட ஆரம் R என்பது,
questions.explanationEn: Radius of Snell's window R = d tan i_c = d / √(n² − 1).
questions.explanationTa: ஸ்னெல் சாளரத்தின் ஆரம் R = d / √(n² − 1).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: In an optical fibre with core refractive index n₁, cladding refractive index n₂, and surrounding medium air (n₃ = 1), the Numerical Aperture (NA) is,
questions.questionTa: உள்ளக ஒளிவிலகல் எண் n₁ மற்றும் உறைபூச்சு ஒளிவிலகல் எண் n₂ கொண்ட ஒளி இழையின் எண்ணியல் துளை (Numerical Aperture - காற்று ஊடகத்தில்) சமன்பாடு யாது?
questions.explanationEn: Numerical Aperture NA = sin i_a = √(n₁² − n₂²).
questions.explanationTa: எண்ணியல் துளை NA = sin i_a = √(n₁² − n₂²).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: Medical endoscopes work on the principle of,
questions.questionTa: மருத்துவத் துறையில் பயன்படும் அகஉள்நோக்கி (Endoscope) எந்தத் தத்துவத்தின் அடிப்படையில் செயல்படுகிறது?
questions.explanationEn: Endoscopes use optical fibre bundles working on total internal reflection.
questions.explanationTa: அகஉள்நோக்கி ஒளி இழைகளின் முழு அக எதிரொளிப்புத் தத்துவத்தின் அடிப்படையில் செயல்படுகிறது.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: An air bubble inside water (n = 1.33) behaves as a,
questions.questionTa: தண்ணீரின் உள்ளே தோன்றும் காற்றுக் குமிழி எவ்வகையான லென்ஸாகச் செயல்படும்?
questions.explanationEn: Since n_air < n_water, a convex air bubble in water acts as a diverging lens.
questions.explanationTa: காற்றின் ஒளிவிலகல் எண் நீரை விடக் குறைவு என்பதால், நீருக்குள் உள்ள காற்றுக் குமிழி விரிக்கும் (குழி) லென்ஸாகச் செயல்படும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: What is the SI unit of power of a lens?
questions.questionTa: லென்சின் திறனின் SI அலகு என்ன?
questions.explanationEn: Power P = 1/f has SI unit dioptre (D), where 1 D = 1 m⁻¹.
questions.explanationTa: லென்சின் திறனின் அலகு டயாப்டர் (D) ஆகும் (1 D = 1 m⁻¹).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: At the position of minimum deviation in a prism,
questions.questionTa: முப்பட்டகத்தின் சிறும திசைமாற்ற நிலையில் கீழ்க்கண்டவற்றுள் எது சரியானது?
optionsEn: the refracted ray inside the prism is parallel to its base
optionsTa: முப்பட்டகத்தினுள் விலகலடைந்த கதிர் அதன் அடிப்பக்கத்திற்கு இணையாகச் செல்லும்
questions.explanationEn: At minimum deviation, i₁ = i₂, r₁ = r₂, and the refracted ray inside the prism is parallel to its base.
questions.explanationTa: சிறும திசைமாற்ற நிலையில் i₁ = i₂, r₁ = r₂ மற்றும் முப்பட்டகத்தினுள் செல்லும் கதிர் அதன் அடிப்பரப்பிற்கு இணையாகச் செல்லும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: The dispersive power (ω) of the material of a prism is given by,
questions.questionTa: ஊடகம் ஒன்றின் நிறப்பிரிகைத் திறனுக்கான (Dispersive power ω) சமன்பாடு யாது?
questions.explanationEn: Dispersive power ω = (n_V − n_R) / (n − 1).
questions.explanationTa: நிறப்பிரிகைத் திறன் ω = (n_V − n_R) / (n − 1).
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: According to Rayleigh's scattering law, the intensity of scattered light (I) is inversely proportional to,
questions.questionTa: இராலே ஒளிச்சிதறல் விதியின்படி, சிதறலடைந்த ஒளியின் செறிவு (I) எதற்கு எதிர்த்தகவில் இருக்கும்?
questions.explanationEn: Rayleigh's scattering law states I ∝ 1/λ⁴.
questions.explanationTa: இராலே ஒளிச்சிதறல் விதியின்படி I ∝ 1/λ⁴.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: In a secondary rainbow, the order of colours from the outside to the inside is,
questions.questionTa: துணை வானவில்லில் (Secondary rainbow) வெளிப்புறத்திலிருந்து உட்புறமாக வண்ணங்களின் வரிசை எவ்வாறு அமையும்?
questions.explanationEn: In a secondary rainbow (52° to 54°), violet is on the outside and red is on the inside.
questions.explanationTa: துணை வானவில்லில் வெளிப்புறத்தில் ஊதா நிறமும் உட்புறத்தில் சிவப்பு நிறமும் தோன்றும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: Clouds appear white because dust and water droplets have size a ≫ λ, so,
questions.questionTa: மேகங்களில் உள்ள நீர்த்துளிகள் மற்றும் தூசுகளின் அளவு ஒளியின் அலைநீளத்தை விட மிகப் பெரியதாக (a ≫ λ) உள்ளதால் மேகங்கள் வெண்மையாகத் தெரியக் காரணம்,
optionsEn: all wavelengths are scattered almost equally
questions.explanationEn: Large particles (a ≫ λ) scatter all wavelengths equally, making clouds appear white.
questions.explanationTa: ஒளியின் அலைநீளத்தை விடப் பெரிய துகள்களால் அனைத்து நிறங்களும் சம அளவில் சிதறலடைவதால் மேகங்கள் வெண்மையாகத் தெரிகின்றன.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: A plane glass is placed over various coloured letters (violet, green, yellow, red). The letter which appears to be raised more is,
questions.questionTa: பல்வேறு வண்ணங்களில் எழுதப்பட்ட எழுத்துகளின் மீது (ஊதா, பச்சை, மஞ்சள், மற்றும் சிவப்பு) சமதளக் கண்ணாடி ஒன்று வைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. எந்த வண்ணத்தில் எழுதப்பட்ட எழுத்து அதிக உயரத்தில் தெரியும்?
questions.explanationEn: Violet has the smallest wavelength and largest refractive index n, so apparent depth d' = d/n is least and it appears raised the most.
questions.explanationTa: ஊதா நிறத்திற்கு ஒளிவிலகல் எண் (n) அதிகம் என்பதால் தோற்ற ஆழம் குறைவாகி, ஊதா எழுத்து அதிக உயரத்தில் தெரியும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: Two point white dots are 1 mm apart on a black paper. They are viewed by eye of pupil diameter 3 mm approximately. The maximum distance at which these dots can be resolved by the eye is, [take wavelength of light, λ = 500 nm]
questions.questionTa: கருமைநிறத் தாளின் மீது 1 mm இடைவெளியில் இரண்டு வெள்ளை நிறப் புள்ளிகள் காணப்படுகின்றன. தோராயமாக 3 mm விட்டமுடைய விழிலென்ஸ் உள்ள விழியினால் இப்புள்ளிகள் பார்க்கப்படுகின்றன. விழியினால் இப்புள்ளிகளைத் தெளிவாகப் பகுத்துப்பார்க்கக்கூடிய பெருமத் தொலைவு என்ன? [λ = 500 nm]
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: In a Young's double-slit experiment, the slit separation is doubled. To maintain the same fringe spacing on the screen, the screen-to-slit distance D must be changed to,
questions.questionTa: யங் இரட்டைப் பிளவு ஆய்வில், பிளவுகளுக்கு இடையே உள்ள தொலைவு இருமடங்காக்கப்படுகிறது. திரையில் தோன்றும் பட்டை அகலம் மாறாமல் இருக்க வேண்டுமெனில், பிளவுகளுக்கும் திரைக்கும் இடையே உள்ள தொலைவு எவ்வளவு இருக்க வேண்டும்?
questions.explanationEn: β = λD / d. When d is doubled, D must be changed to 2D to keep β constant.
questions.explanationTa: β = λD / d. d இருமடங்கானால் β மாறாமல் இருக்க D-ம் 2D ஆக வேண்டும்.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: Two coherent monochromatic light beams of intensities I and 4I are superposed. The maximum and minimum possible intensities in the resulting beam are [IIT-JEE 1988]
questions.questionTa: I மற்றும் 4I ஒளிச்செறிவுகள் கொண்ட இரண்டு ஒற்றை நிற ஓரியல் ஒளிக்கற்றைகள் ஒன்றுடன் ஒன்று மேற்பொருந்துகின்றன. தொகுபயன் பிம்பத்தின் சாத்தியமான பெரும மற்றும் சிறும ஒளிச்செறிவுகள் முறையே [IIT-JEE 1988]
questions.explanationEn: I_max = (√I + √4I)² = 9I and I_min = (√I − √4I)² = I.
questions.explanationTa: I_max = (√I + √4I)² = 9I; I_min = (√I − √4I)² = I.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: When light is incident on a soap film of thickness 5 × 10⁻⁵ cm, the wavelength of light reflected maximum in the visible region is 5320 Å. Refractive index of the film will be,
questions.questionTa: 5 × 10⁻⁵ cm தடிமன் கொண்ட சோப்புப் படலத்தின் மீது ஒளி விழுகிறது. கண்ணுறு பகுதியில் எதிரொளிப்பு அடைந்த ஒளியின் பெரும அலைநீளம் 5320 Å எனில் சோப்புப் படலத்தின் ஒளிவிலகல் எண் என்ன?
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: First diffraction minimum due to a single slit of width 1.0 × 10⁻⁵ cm is at 30°. Then wavelength of light used is,
questions.questionTa: 1.0 × 10⁻⁵ cm அகலம் கொண்ட ஒற்றைப் பிளவினால் ஏற்படும் விளிம்புவிளைவின் முதல் சிறுமம் 30° எனில், பயன்படுத்தப்படும் ஒளியின் அலைநீளம் என்ன?
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: A ray of light strikes a glass plate at an angle 60°. If the reflected and refracted rays are perpendicular to each other, the refractive index of the glass is,
questions.questionTa: கண்ணாடித் தட்டு ஒன்றின் மீது 60° கோணத்தில் ஒளிக்கதிர் விழுகிறது. எதிரொளிப்பு மற்றும் ஒளிவிலகல் அடைந்த ஒளிக்கதிர்கள் இரண்டும் ஒன்றுக்கொன்று செங்குத்தாக அமைந்தால், கண்ணாடியின் ஒளிவிலகல் எண் எவ்வளவு?
questions.explanationEn: By Brewster's law, n = tan i_p = tan 60° = √3.
questions.explanationTa: புரூஸ்டர் விதிப்படி n = tan 60° = √3.
warnings: Supplied answers and textbook references require individual teacher verification

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionEn: One of the Young's double slits is covered with a glass plate as shown in figure. The position of central maximum will,
questions.questionTa: படத்தில் காட்டப்பட்டுள்ள யங் இரட்டைப் பிளவு ஆய்வில் ஒரு துளை கண்ணாடி ஒன்றினால் மூடப்படுகிறது எனில், மையப் பெருமம் எங்கு அமையும்?
questions.explanationEn: The fringe system shifts towards the slit covered by the glass plate (upwards).
questions.explanationTa: மேற்பகுதி பிளவில் கண்ணாடித் தட்டு வைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளதால் மையப் பெருமம் மேல்நோக்கி இடம்பெயரும்.
